arXiv:2608.28491v1 [cs.AI] 28 Aug 2026

AcrossVAM1.0: Particle World Modeling
for Text-Assisted Robot Video Prediction

Yafei Zhang Affiliation:  Across Physical AI, Beijing, China Affiliation:  Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China Email: 18453881970@163.com    Nan Wu ††thanks: Corresponding author. Affiliation:  Across Physical AI, Beijing, China Email: across2026@163.com
Abstract

Predicting robot videos requires both precise motion reasoning and preservation of high-frequency appearance, yet monolithic pixel models entangle these objectives and often conceal their progress behind a strong last-frame baseline. We present AcrossVAM1.0, a lightweight, text-assisted video action model that factorizes future prediction into object-centric motion and dense appearance. A frozen SAM3-DLP codec decomposes four context frames into semantic particles for the robot, arm, and gripper, together with a background latent. A 0.28M-parameter spatio-temporal Transformer aligns particle identities, rolls their states forward, and is modulated by a frozen OpenCLIP instruction embedding through FiLM. A causal dual-stream decoder combines particle-rendered motion with appearance encoded exclusively from the last observed frame; a residual refiner and learned delivery mask produce five future frames without access to future appearance. On our VRS benchmark constructed from diverse real-robot trajectories, particle dynamics reduce trajectory error by 21.0% over persistence. Across three delivery-mask seeds, AcrossVAM1.0 improves future-frame PSNR/SSIM from 19.97/0.796 to 20.573±0.00920.573{\pm}0.009/0.8004±0.00020.8004{\pm}0.0002, while raw particle generation improves motion-region PSNR from 11.89 to 13.23. The delivered model does not yet beat persistence in LPIPS (0.1304±0.00040.1304{\pm}0.0004 versus 0.122), and correct-versus- shuffled language changes trajectory error by only 2.8–3.1%. We report these limitations alongside oracle, negative-control, multi-seed, and per-robot analyses. The results show that explicit particle dynamics are a promising low-dimensional interface for robot video prediction, while robust language grounding and appearance delivery remain the principal open challenges.

1 Introduction

A predictive model of how a scene will evolve is useful for robot planning, representation learning, and data generation. Video prediction offers a general interface because it retains the geometry and appearance needed by downstream visual policies (Finn et al., 2016; Ebert et al., 2018; Du et al., 2023). However, real robot videos present an uncomfortable combination: most pixels are static, small articulated parts determine the action, and the same natural-language instruction can admit visually distinct trajectories. A model can therefore achieve competitive global image metrics by copying the last frame, without learning the motion that matters.

Contemporary world models typically compress the whole frame into a dense latent and learn its temporal evolution (Hafner et al., 2023; Babaeizadeh et al., 2022; Huang et al., 2026). This representation is effective but leaves correspondence, dynamics, and texture synthesis coupled. Object-centric models instead represent a scene as slots or particles (Locatello et al., 2020; Wu et al., 2023; Daniel and Tamar, 2024; Daniel et al., 2026). Their explicit state makes motion easier to inspect, but a compact object bottleneck cannot reconstruct fine texture by itself. Moreover, conditioning a video model on language does not guarantee that its trajectory depends on the instruction.

AcrossVAM1.0 assigns different responsibilities to different representations (Figure 1）。语义粒子描述了整体的几何形状 机器人、手臂和夹具；一个紧凑的 Transformer 可以预测它们的未来状态；和一个 单独的因果外观流恢复细节。语言仅被注入 通过特征调制的动态，这使得其效果可以在 轨迹级别。密集分支观察最后一个上下文框架，但从不观察 未来的帧，因此未来的运动不会通过外观路径泄漏。). Semantic particles describe the geometry of the whole robot, arm, and gripper; a compact Transformer predicts their future states; and a separate causal appearance stream restores detail. Language is injected only into the dynamics through feature-wise modulation, which makes its effect measurable at the trajectory level. The dense branch observes the last context frame but never a future frame, so future motion cannot leak through the appearance path.

我们的贡献是：Our contributions are:

  • •

    我们引入了一种语义锚定的粒子世界模型，可以减少 真实机器人视频动力学到紧凑轨迹问题。其动力核心有 仅 0.28M 可训练参数，并公开零件级运动以进行诊断。We introduce a semantically anchored particle world model that reduces real-robot video dynamics to a compact trajectory problem. Its dynamics core has only 0.28M trainable parameters and exposes part-level motion for diagnosis.

  • •

    我们提出了一种因果运动外观解码器，它结合了预测 具有仅上下文密集外观的粒子几何体，并显式控制 尖锐的静态区域和移动物体保真度之间的权衡。We propose a causal motion–appearance decoder that combines predicted particle geometry with context-only dense appearance and explicitly controls the trade-off between sharp static regions and moving-object fidelity.

  • •

    我们针对持久性、随机语言和随机控制进行评估， 预言粒子、多个种子和每个机器人的分裂。评估确定 既有可靠的动作优势，又有有限的语言基础。We evaluate against persistence, shuffled-language and random controls, oracle particles, multiple seeds, and per-robot splits. The evaluation identifies both a reliable motion benefit and the still-limited degree of language grounding.

2 相关工作Related Work

用于物理交互的视频预测。Video prediction for physical interaction.

视频预测长期以来一直被用作学习身体规律的试验台 无需手动状态注释。早期的动作条件模型预测未来 来自图像和机器人控制的像素，证明视觉预见可以 支持规划和表征学习Video prediction has long served as a test bed for learning physical regularities without manual state annotation. Early action-conditioned models predicted future pixels from images and robot controls, demonstrating that visual foresight can support planning and representation learning(Finn et al., 2016; Ebert et al., 2018)。 这一系列工作与操纵特别相关，因为预测 目标在公共空间中保留对象几何形状、接触事件和场景外观 观察空间。它还暴露了一个特征评估问题：机器人 视频包含较大的静态区域，因此复制最后一个上下文帧可以得分 即使关节运动是错误的。最近的文本引导方法 使用语言来描述所需的演变，并将预测的视频视为 类似策略的接口. This line of work is especially relevant to manipulation because the prediction target preserves object geometry, contact events, and scene appearance in a common observation space. It also exposes a characteristic evaluation problem: robot videos contain large static regions, so copying the last context frame can score well even when articulated motion is wrong. Recent text-guided approaches instead use language to describe a desired evolution and treat predicted video as a policy-like interface(Du et al., 2023)。 AcrossVAM1.0遵循这个条件 公式化，但明确报告全局图像质量和运动区域 质量，使得通过静态复制更难获得持久性的改进。. AcrossVAM1.0 follows this conditional formulation but explicitly reports both global image quality and motion-region quality, making improvement over persistence harder to obtain by static copying.

潜在和扩散世界模型。Latent and diffusion world models.

密集视频预测器逐渐组合了随机潜在变量， 循环状态，并学习特征空间来建模不确定性，同时减少 直接像素预测的成本。 FitVid 表明，经过仔细正则化的潜在 视频模型仍然是随机预测的有力参考Dense video predictors have progressively combined stochastic latent variables, recurrent state, and learned feature spaces to model uncertainty while reducing the cost of direct pixel prediction. FitVid shows that a carefully regularized latent video model remains a strong reference for stochastic prediction(Babaeizadeh et al., 2022)。学习到的潜在世界模型也可以优化 控制相关的动力学，无需在每一步重建每个观察结果. Learned latent world models can also optimize control-relevant dynamics without reconstructing every observation at every step(Hafner et al., 2023)。扩散模型提供了一条补充途径 多模式生成. Diffusion models provide a complementary route to multimodal generation(Ho et al., 2020);扩散强迫将这一观点扩展为 具有独立损坏的标记和灵活的训练序列模型 调节模式; Diffusion Forcing extends this view by training sequence models with independently corrupted tokens and flexible conditioning patterns(Chen et al., 2024)。这些方法获得 富有表现力的密集表示，但运动、对应和高频 外观通常仍然纠缠在相同的潜在过程中。纳米世界模型 询问在故意设计的小模型中可以保留多少预测结构. These methods obtain expressive dense representations, but motion, correspondence, and high-frequency appearance typically remain entangled in the same latent process. Nano World Models ask how much predictive structure can be retained in deliberately small models(Huang et al., 2026)。 AcrossVAM1.0 在放置时分享了这一效率目标 感知和渲染之间的语义粒子瓶颈：小动态 核心预测几何形状，而单独的因果流提供纹理 观察到的上下文。. AcrossVAM1.0 shares this efficiency objective while placing a semantic particle bottleneck between perception and rendering: a small dynamics core predicts geometry, whereas a separate causal stream supplies texture from observed context.

以对象为中心的表示和动态。Object-centric representation and dynamics.

以对象为中心的学习将场景分解为可重用的实体，而不是一个 全局特征图。 Slot Attention 学习可交换的组件表示 从图像Object-centric learning decomposes a scene into reusable entities rather than one global feature map. Slot Attention learns exchangeable component representations from images(Locatello et al., 2020)，SAVi++ 将基于槽的感知扩展到 具有时间传播和更强监督信号的视频, and SAVi++ extends slot-based perception to video with temporal propagation and stronger supervision signals(Elsayed et al., 2022)。 SlotFormer 随后预测未来的插槽状态 使用 Transformer，表明时间推理可以与时间推理分开 解码器. SlotFormer subsequently predicts future slot states with a Transformer, showing that temporal reasoning can be separated from the decoder(Wu et al., 2023)。粒子表征构成空间状态 更明确：DDLP 将外观与位置、规模、深度和存在相关联， 而后来的潜粒子模型研究了这种结构中的长视界动力学 空间. Particle representations make the spatial state more explicit: DDLP associates appearance with position, scale, depth, and presence, while later latent-particle models study long-horizon dynamics in this structured space(Daniel and Tamar, 2024; Daniel et al., 2026)。好处是可解释性和 紧凑的运动接口；成本是可交换实体需要时间 对应，并且可能会丢弃真实感渲染所需的纹理。套装 预测通常通过二分分配来解决排列歧义. The benefit is interpretability and a compact motion interface; the cost is that exchangeable entities require temporal correspondence and may discard texture needed for photorealistic rendering. Set prediction commonly addresses permutation ambiguity with bipartite assignment(Carion et al., 2020)。 AcrossVAM1.0 将这些想法专门应用于关节型机器人： VRS 监督锚定整个机器人、手臂和夹具粒子，匈牙利匹配 支持无序提案，并且密集的残差代码恢复了外观 不应该强迫通过低维运动状态。 最近的扩展使两个轴都变得锐利：OCK 显式地增强了对象槽 位置、速度和加速度. AcrossVAM1.0 specializes these ideas to articulated robots: VRS supervision anchors whole-robot, arm, and gripper particles, Hungarian matching supports unordered proposals, and a dense residual code restores appearance that should not be forced through the low-dimensional motion state. Recent extensions sharpen both axes: OCK explicitly augments object slots with position, velocity, and acceleration(Song et al., 2025)，而 TextOCVP 使用 用于语言引导预测的文本条件槽 Transformer, while TextOCVP uses a text-conditioned slot Transformer for language-guided prediction(Villar-Corrales et al., 2026).

基础感知和语言调节。Foundation perception and language conditioning.

大型冻结编码器可以提供语义结构，而不需要同等的 大型可训练预测器。快速分割模型，例如 SAM 和 SAM2 跨不同场景和视频传输对象蒙版Large frozen encoders can provide semantic structure without requiring an equally large trainable predictor. Promptable segmentation models such as SAM and SAM2 transfer object masks across diverse scenes and video(Kirillov et al., 2023; Ravi et al., 2024)。 CLIP 和 OpenCLIP 提供与视觉一致的可转移文本表示 概念. CLIP and OpenCLIP provide transferable text representations aligned with visual concepts(Radford et al., 2021; Cherti et al., 2023)，而 FiLM 注入调节 通过特征仿射调制信号, while FiLM injects a conditioning signal through feature-wise affine modulation(Perez et al., 2018)。这些 组件使语言调节变得便宜，但它们本身的存在就可以 不证明预测轨迹取决于指令：模型 可能依赖于场景先验、数据集偏差或观察到的运动前缀。我们因此 冻结感知和语言塔，仅将 FiLM 应用于粒子动力学，以及 根据打乱的、伪文本和随机标签控件评估正确的文本。 这种设计将语义感知与因果语言使用分开，并激励 我们的保守术语. These components make language conditioning inexpensive, but their presence alone does not demonstrate that a predicted trajectory depends on the instruction: a model may rely on scene priors, dataset bias, or the observed motion prefix. We therefore freeze perception and language towers, apply FiLM only to particle dynamics, and evaluate correct text against shuffled, pseudo-text, and random-label controls. This design separates semantic perception from causal language use and motivates our conservative term文本辅助text-assisted而不是指令控制的。rather than instruction-controlled.

AcrossVAM1.0的定位。Positioning of AcrossVAM1.0.

先前的工作通常强调密集的视觉保真度、紧凑的潜在 动力学，或以对象为中心的可解释性。 AcrossVAM1.0 将这些目标结合在一起 将它们分配给不同的模块：冻结的语义感知定义粒子， 0.28M 参数 Transformer 模拟它们的运动，以及仅上下文的外观 路径执行剩余传递。因此，最接近的比较是 互补而不是互换：密集预测器测试图像质量， 槽和粒子模型测试结构化动力学和语言条件视频 模型测试语义响应能力。我们的评估反映了这种分解 具有持久性、运动区域、粒子预言、语言控制、多种子和 跨机器人诊断。Prior work generally emphasizes either dense visual fidelity, compact latent dynamics, or object-centric interpretability. AcrossVAM1.0 combines these aims by assigning them to distinct modules: frozen semantic perception defines particles, a 0.28M-parameter Transformer models their motion, and a context-only appearance path performs residual delivery. The closest comparisons are therefore complementary rather than interchangeable: dense predictors test image quality, slot and particle models test structured dynamics, and language-conditioned video models test semantic responsiveness. Our evaluation mirrors this decomposition with persistence, motion-region, particle-oracle, language-control, multi-seed, and cross-robot diagnostics.

4 实验Experiments

4.1 设置Setup

数据和协议。Data and protocol.

我们根据不同的 DROID 风格的真实机器人轨迹构建视频机器人分割 (VRS) 基准We construct the Video Robot Segmentation (VRS) benchmark from diverse DROID-style real-robot trajectories(Khazatsky et al., 2024)，用整个机器人、手臂和夹具的面罩进行增强 和自然语言命令。该清单包含 2,746 个带标签的剪辑： 2,526/106/105 分配给训练/验证/测试，排除 9 条记录 来自固定协议。我们调整框架大小, augmented with masks for whole robot, arm, and gripper and a natural-language command. The manifest contains 2,746 labeled clips: 2,526/106/105 are assigned to train/validation/test and nine records are excluded from the fixed protocol. We resize frames to128×128128\times 128，九帧样本 步长为 3 的窗口，观察 4 个帧，并预测 5 个。未来-视频 测试包含92个片段和460个预测帧；编解码器重建使用 48 个剪辑 和 432 帧；轨迹诊断使用 368 个保留窗口。平台包括 Franka、WidowX、Mobile ALOHA、Google Robot、Fanuc、Sawyer、Stretch、UR5、Kuka IIWA、 和 xArm。, sample nine-frame windows at stride three, observe four frames, and predict five. The future-video test contains 92 clips and 460 predicted frames; codec reconstruction uses 48 clips and 432 frames; trajectory diagnostics use 368 held-out windows. Platforms include Franka, WidowX, Mobile ALOHA, Google Robot, Fanuc, Sawyer, Stretch, UR5, Kuka IIWA, and xArm.

衡量标准和选择。Metrics and selection.

我们报告 PSNR、SSIMWe report PSNR, SSIM(Wang et al., 2004)，和LPIPS, and LPIPS(Zhang et al., 2018)总的来说 未来像素，加上扩张运动/前景区域中的 PSNR。检查站和 根据验证数据选择混合阈值；测试评估一次。 持久性副本over all future pixels, plus PSNR in a dilated motion/foreground region. Checkpoints and blending thresholds are selected on validation data; test is evaluated once. Persistence copies𝒙C{\bm{x}}_{C}。粒子预言机使用真实的未来粒子， 像素预言机选择每个像素的生成或持久性；两者都是上层 边界，而不是可部署的方法。. The particle oracle uses ground-truth future particles, and the pixel oracle chooses generation or persistence per pixel; both are upper bounds, not deployable methods.

实施。Implementation.

粒子Transformer宽度为64，两层，四个头，0.28M参数。 完整的可训练未来预测堆栈具有大约 950 万个参数， 不包括冻结的 SAM3-DLP 和 OpenCLIP 主干网。我们训练编解码器、动力学、 外观和分阶段交付模块。附录The particle Transformer has width 64, two layers, four heads, and 0.28M parameters. The complete trainable future-prediction stack has approximately 9.5M parameters, excluding frozen SAM3-DLP and OpenCLIP backbones. We train codec, dynamics, appearance, and delivery modules in stages. AppendixA给出详细信息。gives details.

4.2 未来视频预测Future video prediction

表Table1暴露了核心的权衡。原始颗粒调节 生成将运动 PSNR 比持久性提高了 1.34 dB，但降低了全局性能 SSIM 因为它修改了简单的静态像素。剩余交付恢复静态 保真度并将全局 PSNR 提高 0.61 dB，SSIM 提高 0.0044，同时保留 大多数运动优势。递送面膜种子之间的分散度很小 （0.009 dB PSNR 和 0.0002 SSIM），但此扫描共享所有上行检查点和 因此衡量交付的稳健性而不是完全的端到端不确定性。 LPIPS 仍比持久性差 0.0082。 1.55 dB 的预言差距表明 候选质量并不是唯一的瓶颈：决定在哪里合成仍然存在 不完美的。exposes the central trade-off. Raw particle-conditioned generation improves motion PSNR by 1.34 dB over persistence, but degrades global SSIM because it modifies easy static pixels. Residual delivery recovers static fidelity and improves global PSNR by 0.61 dB and SSIM by 0.0044 while retaining most of the motion advantage. Dispersion across delivery-mask seeds is small (0.009 dB PSNR and 0.0002 SSIM), but this sweep shares all upstream checkpoints and therefore measures delivery robustness rather than full end-to-end uncertainty. LPIPS remains 0.0082 worse than persistence. The 1.55 dB oracle gap indicates that candidate quality is not the only bottleneck: deciding where to synthesize remains imperfect.

我们调查了过去五年发布的公共方法：密集随机 预测器 FitVid、基于槽的 SlotFormer、基于粒子的 DDLP、基于槽的 TextOCVP、 和基于粒子的 LPWM。全部提供公共实现，但没有报告 固定 VRS 分割、四帧上下文、五帧水平和运动区域度量 在这里使用。因此，我们将测量结果分开（表We surveyed public methods released in the past five years: the dense stochastic predictor FitVid, slot-based SlotFormer, particle-based DDLP, slot-based TextOCVP, and particle-based LPWM. All provide public implementations, but none reports the fixed VRS split, four-frame context, five-frame horizon, and motion-region metric used here. We therefore separate measured results (Table1）从 复制队列（表) from the reproduction queue (Table2）而不是混合 来自 BAIR、CLEVRER、OBJ3D 或 LanguageTable 的不相称的数字。繁殖 遵循优先级 LPWM-Language、TextOCVP、FitVid、DDLP 和 SlotFormer。) rather than mixing incommensurate numbers from BAIR, CLEVRER, OBJ3D, or LanguageTable. 4.4 代表性和动态Representation and dynamics

添加一个Adding a32×32×432\times 32\times 4残差码将重构 PSNR 提高了 7.01 dB （表residual code raises reconstruction PSNR by 7.01 dB (Table5），激励双流而不是强迫 通过对象状态的纹理。小动力学模型可靠地击败了轨迹 跨种子的持久性。诊断表明残差框坐标和 原始外观功能引入了快捷方式；删除它们并使用步幅三 运动将误差降低率从低个位数提高到 21.0%。), motivating a dual stream rather than forcing texture through object state. The small dynamics model reliably beats trajectory persistence across seeds. Diagnostics show that residualized box coordinates and raw appearance features introduce shortcuts; removing them and using stride-three motion raises error reduction from low single digits to 21.0%.

4.6 消融和解释Ablations and interpretation

表Table7总结了组件和交付消融。 原始几何状态优于编解码器盒残差：后者表现出 34.4% 的速度符号翻转率和模糊的物理位移。迈出三步 使有意义的运动在 128 像素分辨率下可见。外观有用 渲染但作为动态快捷方式是有害的。在输送侧，固定颗粒 与原始生成相比，alpha 将 PSNR 提高了 0.23 dB，而学习到的因果掩模 再增加 0.41 dB 并将 SSIM 恢复到持久性之上。这项改进交易 0.36 dB 的运动 PSNR，可显着提高静态区域保真度；神谕 显示模板校准仍留有 1.55 dB 的 PSNR 余量。表summarizes the component and delivery ablations. Raw geometric state is preferable to codec box residuals: the latter exhibit a 34.4% velocity sign-flip rate and obscure physical displacement. Stride three makes meaningful motion visible at 128-pixel resolution. Appearance is useful for rendering but harmful as a dynamics shortcut. On the delivery side, fixed particle alpha improves PSNR by 0.23 dB over raw generation, whereas the learned causal mask adds another 0.41 dB and restores SSIM above persistence. This improvement trades 0.36 dB of motion PSNR for substantially better static-region fidelity; the oracle shows that mask calibration still leaves 1.55 dB of PSNR headroom. Table6提供补充性语言消融。槽位匹配的影响可以忽略不计 正如预期的那样，位于固定 ID 缓存中，但对于无序提案仍然是必需的。provides the complementary language ablation. Slot matching has negligible effect in the fixed-ID cache, as expected, but remains necessary for unordered proposals.

5 局限性Limitations

AcrossVAM1.0还不是通用的动作模型。它预测未来只有五个 帧于AcrossVAM1.0 is not yet a general-purpose action model. It predicts only five future frames at1282128^{2}分辨率并在编解码器构建期间使用部分掩码。的 尽管可训练的动态很小，但冻结的 OpenCLIP 塔很大，因此resolution and uses part masks during codec construction. The frozen OpenCLIP tower is large even though the trainable dynamics are small, so轻量级lightweight指的是学习到的预测核心而不是总体部署 记忆。相对于持久性的全球收益是适度的，公共模型基线尚未在相同的 VRS 分割上重新训练，LPIPS 更糟糕，语言 敏感性有限，跨实施例泛化不一致。 像素预言机还揭示了传输校准是一个主要瓶颈。未来 工作应该学习不确定性感知混合，收集反事实指令 配对，用提议时间分割替换掩模监督，并评估 闭环控制而不是单独的视频指标。refers to the learned predictive core rather than total deployment memory. Global gains over persistence are modest, public-model baselines are not yet retrained on the identical VRS split, LPIPS is worse, language sensitivity is limited, and cross-embodiment generalization is inconsistent. The pixel oracle also reveals delivery calibration as a major bottleneck. Future work should learn uncertainty-aware blending, collect counterfactual instruction pairs, replace mask supervision with proposal-time segmentation, and evaluate closed-loop control rather than video metrics alone.

6 结论Conclusion

我们推出了 AcrossVAM1.0，这是一种处理机器人视频的紧凑文本辅助世界模型 预测作为语义粒子动力学加上因果外观合成。的 模型改进了残差传输时的轨迹和运动区域预测 恢复大部分静态视觉保真度。强有力的控制表明了什么 有效——低维运动建模——以及尚未解决的问题——感知 交付、语言依赖和跨机器人传输。这种分离提供了 不隐藏故障模式的可解释视频动作模型的基础 背后是聚合图像指标。We introduced AcrossVAM1.0, a compact text-assisted world model that treats robot video prediction as semantic particle dynamics plus causal appearance synthesis. The model improves trajectories and motion-region prediction while residual delivery recovers much of the static visual fidelity. Strong controls show both what works—low-dimensional motion modeling—and what remains unresolved—perceptual delivery, language dependence, and cross-robot transfer. This separation provides a foundation for interpretable video action models without hiding failure modes behind aggregate image metrics.

固定协议。Fixed protocol.

所有模型选择均使用 2,526 个训练片段和 106 个验证片段。 105号 测试清单剪辑从不用于检查点或阈值选择。阶段 当需要完整的 RGB、蒙版、粒子缓存和文本时，包含较少的剪辑 记录；每个主表报告有效样本数。All model selection uses 2,526 training and 106 validation clips. The 105 test-manifest clips are never used for checkpoint or threshold selection. 优化阶段。Optimization stages.

我们（i）训练并冻结粒子编解码器； (ii) 缓存粒子； (三) 火车 过渡和推出动态； (iv) 训练密集先验和残差精炼器 使用卷展粒子； (v) 训练推理安全混合掩模。动态 配置有维度 64、两层、四个头、九个时间步长、四个 上下文步骤和三个槽。未来预测是自回归的。We (i) train and freeze the particle codec; (ii) cache particles; (iii) train transition and rollout dynamics; (iv) train the dense prior and residual refiner using rollout particles; and (v) train the inference-safe blend mask. The dynamics configuration has dimension 64, two layers, four heads, nine time steps, four context steps, and three slots. Future prediction is autoregressive.

视频世界模型可以支持数据高效的机器人学习和更安全的离线 分析，但如果将其视为不准确的推出，可能会鼓励不安全的行为 物质保障。 AcrossVAM1.0 是一个研究原型，不应用作 安全控制器。它的数据可以编码实施例、实验室和注释 偏见。零件级可视化可以暴露故障，但不能消除故障 需要现实世界的验证和适当的安全约束。Video world models can support data-efficient robot learning and safer offline analysis, but inaccurate rollouts can encourage unsafe actions if treated as physical guarantees. AcrossVAM1.0 is a research prototype and should not be used as a safety controller. Its data may encode embodiment, laboratory, and annotation biases. Part-level visualization can expose failures, but does not eliminate the need for real-world validation and appropriate safety constraints.
